policy.selection: Choose the smallest group that protects the behavior changed in the current task. Combine groups only when the change crosses their contracts.
policy.failure: Fix failures caused by the current change and rerun the group. If a failure is unrelated, prove that with the smallest focused reproduction and stop on a real blocker; do not hand off a raw failure inventory.
policy.fullSuite: upstream-all is not routine validation. Run it only when the user explicitly requests it, a shared test harness changes, or a mechanical workspace-wide change makes focused selection unreliable. A reason is mandatory.

smoke.purpose: Prove that the current VSP binary builds and reaches minimal CLI, TUI, and app-server interactions.
smoke.value: Catches broken builds, wrong binary wiring, startup crashes, blank TUI first frames, and app-server handshake regressions.
useWhen: Before handing off Rust product, CI, or packaging changes
When startup, CLI routing, TUI bootstrap, or app-server launch changes
prerequisites: Rust toolchain and locked Cargo dependencies
Linux or macOS because the TUI probe uses a PTY

build-contracts.purpose: Validate compile-drift fixtures, Cargo/Bazel binary unit-test parity, enabled doctests, and Bazel package loading.
build-contracts.value: Prevents API fixtures and binary-root tests from compiling under Cargo while being silently missing or unloadable under Bazel.
useWhen: Cargo targets, Config/protocol fixtures, Bazel crate rules, or test binary dependencies change
A test exists in a binary root and must remain visible to both Cargo and Bazel
prerequisites: Rust toolchain and Cargo
Bazel
Native bwrap behavior is validated separately; Cargo commands in this group skip its embedded build

cli.purpose: Validate one named CLI parsing, doctor, update, or command-routing behavior.
cli.value: Protects user-facing diagnostics and command semantics without running unrelated core or TUI integration tests.
useWhen: Files under codex-rs/cli change
Command flags, doctor output, update policy, or top-level routing changes
prerequisites: A test-name filter tied to the changed CLI behavior

core.purpose: Validate one named codex-core behavior across request construction, tools, config, goals, conversation state, or host integration.
core.value: Core has a very large suite; a required name filter preserves high-signal behavioral coverage without importing unrelated failures.
useWhen: Files under codex-rs/core change
A shared protocol or tool change alters core behavior
prerequisites: A test-name filter tied to the changed behavior

app-server.purpose: Validate one named public JSON-RPC behavior in the app-server implementation or remote client.
app-server.value: Protects externally observable request, notification, process, and handoff behavior without running the whole app-server suite.
useWhen: Files under codex-rs/app-server or codex-rs/app-server-client change
Public JSON-RPC behavior or app-server/core routing changes
prerequisites: A test-name filter tied to the changed API behavior

exec.purpose: Validate one named headless exec parsing, event projection, final-output, or resume behavior.
exec.value: Protects machine-readable and terminal exec output, where stale or missing final messages can silently break automation.
useWhen: Files under codex-rs/exec change
Headless event projection, final message, JSONL, resume, or CLI execution behavior changes
prerequisites: A test-name filter tied to the changed exec behavior

protocol.purpose: Validate the complete app-server protocol wire model and generated-schema contract.
protocol.value: The crate is small and its tests catch Rust/TypeScript/JSON shape drift at the public API boundary.
useWhen: Files under codex-rs/app-server-protocol change
A public request, response, notification, field, enum, or experimental marker changes
prerequisites: Regenerated schema fixtures when API shapes change

tui.purpose: Validate one named TUI rendering, input, streaming, replay, or routing behavior and surface snapshot changes for review.
tui.value: Focused TUI tests preserve user-visible behavior while avoiding known unrelated failures in the broad upstream suite.
useWhen: Files under codex-rs/tui change
User-visible terminal output, interaction, streaming, replay, or routing changes
prerequisites: A test-name filter tied to the changed UI behavior
Review every generated .snap.new file before acceptance

persistence.purpose: Validate rollout persistence plus VSP session compatibility and resume classification.
persistence.value: Protects durable user history and cross-version session behavior, where regressions can strand or misclassify existing sessions.
useWhen: Rollout, history, session metadata, resume, migration, or compatibility logic changes
Release work changes serialized state
prerequisites: Rust and Python 3

release.purpose: Validate package, installer, session-compatibility, and preview-release logic without publishing or installing.
release.value: Catches artifact metadata, archive layout, installer policy, and release assembly regressions before release operations.
useWhen: Packaging, installer, version, release, or artifact scripts change
Before preparing a VSP preview release
prerequisites: Python 3

sdk-typescript.purpose: Validate one TypeScript SDK Jest file against the current VSP binary.
sdk-typescript.value: Protects SDK process, streaming, abort, and option behavior while keeping the runtime under explicit VSP control.
useWhen: Files under sdk/typescript change
CLI JSONL, process, streaming, or abort behavior used by the SDK changes
prerequisites: pnpm install completed from pnpm-lock.yaml
A Jest test-file path filter

sdk-python.purpose: Validate the Python SDK resolver and public app-server handshake against the current checkout binary.
sdk-python.value: Separates published-runtime compatibility from source-tree compatibility so an old pinned wheel cannot make current code look tested.
useWhen: Files under sdk/python change
App-server initialize, model-list, process launch, or binary packaging behavior changes
prerequisites: Rust toolchain and Cargo
uv with the sdk/python lockfile available

security.purpose: Validate the apply-patch parser and filesystem mutation boundary.
security.value: These tests protect a compact, security-sensitive parser and mutation surface with real filesystem effects.
useWhen: Apply-patch parsing or filesystem mutation changes
Tool execution changes affect patch application semantics
prerequisites: Rust toolchain

linux-sandbox.purpose: Validate the native Linux sandbox and embedded bubblewrap build on a provisioned Linux host.
linux-sandbox.value: Proves real filesystem and socket denial behavior instead of accepting missing commands, DNS failures, or generic non-zero exits.
useWhen: Linux sandbox, permission-profile, bubblewrap, or network-isolation code changes
Preparing a Linux release candidate
prerequisites: Linux host with sandbox kernel features enabled
pkg-config and libcap development headers
/bin/bash

v8-runtime.purpose: Validate real embedded V8 initialization, evaluation, CRDTP parsing, and sandbox linkage.
v8-runtime.value: Keeps the experimental runtime grounded in linked V8 behavior instead of static labels or configuration strings.
useWhen: Files under codex-rs/v8-poc change
The pinned V8 artifact, linkage, sandbox feature, or CRDTP behavior changes
prerequisites: Pinned rusty_v8 artifact is available

hypo-external.purpose: Validate cross-repository Hypo-Workflow release-manifest and fixture compatibility.
hypo-external.value: Detects drift between the host fork and the external Workflow contract without pretending a missing checkout is a pass.
useWhen: Host contract, Workflow command surface, projected status, or Hypo-Workflow release integration changes
prerequisites: HYPO_WORKFLOW_ROOT points to a compatible Hypo-Workflow checkout

upstream-all.purpose: Run the complete inherited upstream nextest workspace suite for an explicitly owned investigation.
upstream-all.value: Useful only when focused selection is unreliable; it is not a VSP correctness score and known failures must not be dumped as an unowned report.
useWhen: The user explicitly requests the full upstream suite
A shared test harness changes
A mechanical workspace-wide change makes focused selection unreliable
prerequisites: cargo-nextest
Enough time and disk for the full workspace
A written reason and ownership of resulting failures
